name: stat
title: Stat
description: Count voice with label, unit, delta signal and an optional meter.
whenToUse: Use Stat for one headline figure with its unit and change, and Meter for a quantity against a limit. For a task in progress use Progress; for many values use Chart or Table.

parts.name: Meter
parts.description: A measured quantity in a 1px frame (Base UI Meter). Ink fill; red when over `high`. Value is announced by Base UI Meter. Given `label`, it renders its parts itself; pass children (the parts) to compose them instead.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: The parts, composed: MeterLabel, MeterValue, MeterTrack with MeterIndicator.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: The label and value are visible by default; hide them only when the surrounding text already says both (e.g. inside Stat).

props.name: high
props.description: Over this value the fill and the readout turn red.

parts.name: MeterIndicator
parts.description: The fill (Base UI Meter.Indicator): ink, red when over `high`.

parts.name: MeterLabel
parts.description: What is measured (Base UI Meter.Label): it names the meter.

parts.name: MeterTrack
parts.description: The frame (Base UI Meter.Track): a k1 keyline box, 10px tall.

parts.name: MeterValue
parts.description: The readout in the Code voice (Base UI Meter.Value), red when over `high`. Hidden from assistive technology: the meter announces its value.

parts.name: Stat
parts.description: A metric: label, the Count voice, unit as code, and an optional delta and meter. The delta is a shape + text, coloured only when it needs attention (tone="bad" → red).

props.name: delta
props.type: { value: ReactNode; direction: "flat" | "up" | "down"; tone?: "neutral" | "good" | "bad" | undefined; label?: string | undefined; }

props.name: label
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: meter
props.type: { value: number; max?: number | undefined; label?: string | undefined; }

props.name: unit
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: value
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
